findings.issue: Unsupported date. 'In 1895 Pope Leo XIII ordered ...' dates the papal order to 1895. Neither cited source dates it. The editors' note says only that Leo XIII granted the coronation 'Últimamente' (lately), and that the coronation was to take place on 12 October 1895. The prologue says it would be done in the Pope's name and by his order. Standard accounts date the grant to 1887. Also, both sources speak of the coronation as still to come, so the note should not state a past order in 1895.
